name: do_not_reuse_ambient_module_name_resolut_9c093c13
subject: Do not reuse ambient module name resolution from other files while determining if resolution can be reused (#59243)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Removes the unsafe reuse of ambient module name resolutions from other files during program structure reuse, which could wrongly reuse resolutions across watch/program updates. Mostly a correctness fix in program reuse logic.
